scope: all descendants of v269 and later active-parent candidates
honesty_note: D6-D9 and prior external blocks have been repeatedly observed. This protocol ranks development descendants only; final proof requires a separately frozen future block.

development_anchor.role: historical anchor; improvement alone cannot promote

primary_test.metric: pooled exact-top3 race logloss delta versus active parent

multiplicity.family: all complete descendants tested against the same active parent
multiplicity.test: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over paired daily mean logloss deltas versus active parent

external_policy.final_proof_requires: a separately frozen future block with no model, feature, threshold, parent, or candidate selection after outcomes are opened
